summary: Build conflict management and de-escalation skills through practical role-play, negotiation tools, and workplace resolution plans. Enrol today.
lede: Conflict management training helps people managers, HR professionals and service leaders address workplace disagreements before they escalate. It develops skills in conflict diagnosis, active listening and verbal de-escalation, then applies principled negotiation to reach and document resolution agreements. Scenario analysis and role-play also build judgment about when safety or conduct concerns require escalation and how to keep case notes focused on necessary information.
audienceIntro: Conflict management training is designed for professionals who regularly address disagreement, emotional reactions, complaints, conduct concerns, or relationship breakdowns in teams and service environments.
modules: Conflict Strategy, Reporting, and Action Planning
prerequisites: Prior experience supervising people, handling workplace disagreements, supporting employee relations, managing customer complaints, or coordinating cross-functional work is recommended. No legal qualification, counselling credential, coding experience, or software development knowledge is required. You should bring one anonymised conflict scenario or recurring tension pattern for application during exercises. Advanced concepts such as sentiment analysis and digital case workflows are taught at operational application level, not technical engineering level.
